description_en: Two-element (name and ID card number) verification. Used to verify whether the name and ID card number entered by a user belong to the same person
description_zh: 二要素（姓名和身份证）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、身份证两项信息是否属于同一用户
name: CertNoTwoElementVerification

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

> In **Cell Phone Number Service** -> [**Tag Marketplace**](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square), select a tag and submit an application for use. After the application is approved, you will obtain the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

> 在**号码百科**->[**标签广场**](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后，会获得该授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en: The ID card number to be verified
parameters.name: cert_no
